guards_reviewed.ancestry_contract: Binds S4 recipe, source, split, propensity dependency, checkpoint/model parity, normalization identities and training-state resume contract to S4 seed 4.
guards_reviewed.artifact_bounds: Hashes selected model, epoch-2 checkpoint, training state, provenance and history under per-file and 128 MB aggregate bounds; no inference or optimizer replay.
guards_reviewed.finite_fp32_state: Checks model tensors are FP32, finite, shape/inventory/parameter-count bound; checks strict Muon/AdamW groups, exact optimizer state membership, FP32 finite optimizer tensors and completed step counts.
guards_reviewed.fit_counters: Reconciles the three withheld-evaluation epochs, ordered diagnostics/history/progress, 22,380 updates, 1,119 batches, zero skipped updates and zero nonfinite gradient steps.
guards_reviewed.membership: Checks ordered train, fit-valid and evaluation row-group sequences against the current component-disjoint F0 split; validates identities, no fit/evaluation component overlap, and expected counts.
guards_reviewed.restricted_loader: Uses torch.load(weights_only=True) and the narrow observed safe-global allowlist including torch.torch_version.TorchVersion; hashes before load and rechecks file identity after load.
guards_reviewed.source_manifest: Requires exactly 164 unique manifest entries, source/admission map equality, bounded aggregate bytes, safe relative paths, and actual per-file SHA-256 checks against the manifest.

notes: The pinned terminal raw_sha256 is the recorded read-only health response digest; the remote verifier independently rechecks fresh systemd native exit identity/status.
pending_gates: Conditional source readiness does not claim the remote preflight or terminal checker has run.
